args.message:
Fix round_money to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212

round_money used ROUND_HALF_UP despite its docstring and FIN-212
specifying banker's rounding. Switch to ROUND_HALF_EVEN so
tests/test_money.py passes in the nightly build.

args.head: fin-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary
`src/money.py:round_money` used `ROUND_HALF_UP`, but its docstring and FIN-212 specify banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`). This broke the nightly build because `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even` expects half-to-even behavior (e.g. `2.665 -> 2.66`).

## Change
- Switched `rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP` to `rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN` in `src/money.py`. No other changes needed.

## Test plan
- [x] CI run `ci-0001` on this branch passed.

Fixes the nightly build failure for `tests/test_money.py`.

**Fix** — `src/money.py:round_money` was quantizing with `ROUND_HALF_UP` despite its docstring and FIN-212 specifying banker's rounding. I changed it to use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` (a one-line fix, no other changes needed), which satisfies `tests/test_money.py` (e.g. `2.665 → 2.66`).

**Workflow**
1. Created branch `fin-212-bankers-rounding` and committed the fix.
2. Triggered CI (run `ci-0001`) — passed.
3. Attempted to open a PR but was rejected because the branch was behind main; merged latest main into the branch.
4. Re-ran CI (run `ci-0002`) on the updated branch — passed.
5. Opened **PR #101** against `main` with alex requested as reviewer: https://git.example/payments-service/pull/101

The PR is now awaiting alex's review; per policy I did not merge into main.
